title: Permutation in String
description:
Both strings have only lowercase letters. Return true if s2 contains s1's letters in some order as a substring (all next to each other, no gaps).

s1 = "ab", s2 = "eidbaooo" → true ("ba")
s1 = "ab", s2 = "eidboaoo" → false
tracePrompt: Trace of "ab", "eidbaooo": one row per window of length 2, until it returns

tests.name: Letters there, but not next to each other
Repeated letters must match in number
